mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sa_project(name, code, description, created_by) VALUES(#{name}, #{code}, #{description}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sa_project WHERE code=#{code} AND id != #{excludeProjectId})
SELECT * FROM sa_project WHERE id=#{projectId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sa_project SET name=#{name}, code=#{code}, description=#{description} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE sa_project SET status='ARCHIVED', archived_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{projectId} AND status='ACTIVE'

sql.if: AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR p.code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_project p JOIN sa_project_member pm ON pm.project_id=p.id AND pm.user_id=#{userId} AND pm.status='ACTIVE' WHERE 1=1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_project_member pm JOIN sa_user u ON u.id=pm.user_id WHERE pm.project_id=#{projectId} AND pm.status='ACTIVE' AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%')) AND pm.role=#{query.role}
SELECT * FROM sa_project_member WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_project_member WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND role='OWNER' AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE sa_project_member SET role=#{role},status='ACTIVE',joined_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,removed_at=NULL WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='REMOVED'
UPDATE sa_project_member SET role=#{role} WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE sa_project_member SET status='REMOVED',removed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE'
